name: route-focus
title: Route focus
description: After a client-side navigation it moves focus to the new page's heading and announces the title once, as the browser does for full loads.
docs: Mount it once in the root layout and pass the pathname from your router (usePathname() in Next.js). When the path changes it moves focus to the page's main heading, or to the element you name with target (a selector or a ref), and says the page title once in a polite live region. The first render, a change of hash or query string, and a navigation while the person is typing in a field do nothing to focus. The target gets a temporary tabindex of -1 and shows no outline unless focus arrived by keyboard. Pass resetScroll if your router does not scroll to the top by itself.
